pinned_comment: Qual é a sua reação quando o alarme toca? 🔔
notes: Five real reactions, each with its own print, under a persistent 'prints reais de clientes diferentes' label. 'carai / estourou' is from another group member (ASSETS.md), tagged 'reação de outro membro do grupo'. 'Que chique kk' comes from alarme-12335-itens (that is where ASSETS.md lists it; alarme-12335-itens is not in the index). The build caption 'E esse aqui tava vendo um filme…' is our own paraphrase; the verbatim line appears in the print. Laughter trimmed to 'kkkkkkk' in the big caption (the print shows the full line). The KizuBot alert motif plays on each alarm print.
